model.summary: Model favors SF by 6.9 points (70% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (SF +4.6), Rest days (home minus away) (SEA +1.7), Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (SEA +1.3). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 43.5 total points (SF 25, SEA 18). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 2.2), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.8), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 1.2). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
